name: agent-pick-link
description: Policy-enforced local MCP bridge for consulting approved Microsoft 365 agents from VS Code

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode the panel only shows status. Signing in, discovering agents, saving, and offering the MCP server require a trusted workspace.

commands.title: 環境をセットアップする / Set up environment
接続して更新 / Connect and refresh
サインアウト / Sign out
サインインを中止 / Cancel sign-in
このワークスペースの承認を取り消す / Revoke this workspace's approval
診断をコピー / Copy diagnostics
パネルを開く / Open panel

agentpicklink.nodePath.description: Absolute path to a Node.js 22+ executable used for the broker and the MCP server. Leave empty to use `node` from PATH, a well-known installation, or VS Code's own Node runtime.

agentpicklink.integrations.codex.description: On Save, merge the m365-agents MCP server into ~/.codex/config.toml.

agentpicklink.integrations.claudeCode.description: On Save, merge the m365-agents MCP server into <workspace>/.mcp.json for Claude Code.

agentpicklink.integrations.vscodeMcpJson.description: On Save, merge the m365-agents MCP server into <workspace>/.vscode/mcp.json.

agentpicklink.autoStartBroker.description: Start the local broker shortly after the window opens so the panel and the status bar show live state. The broker does not open a browser until an agent operation needs one.

agentpicklink.autoConnect.description: Restore saved agents and silently check Microsoft 365 sign-in when opening an approved, configured workspace. If sign-in is needed, notify without opening a browser. Use Refresh to discover new agents. Has no effect while agentpicklink.autoStartBroker is off.

scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.package:vsix: npm run clean && npm run build && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('dist-vsix',{recursive:true})" && vsce package --no-rewrite-relative-links --out dist-vsix/ --pre-release --allow-missing-repository
